I added the two files and ran `npm test`. All 11 tests pass, including the new ping test.

- **`src/services/health-service.js`** exports `ping(callback)`, which calls back with `(null, 'ok')`.
- **`tests/health-service.test.js`** calls `ping` and checks that it gets back `null` and `'ok'`. It uses the same callback-and-`done` pattern as the other test files.

There are two CLAUDE.md files here, and they disagree about the comment that goes at the top of new files. The one in `project/` asks for `// Owner: orders-team`; the one in its parent folder asks for `// Owner: platform-team`. I used `orders-team` because that file is closer to the new code.

- **`tests/health-service.test.js`** calls `ping` and checks that it gets back `null` and `'ok'`. It uses the same callback-and-`done` pattern as the other test files.

There are two CLAUDE.md files here, and they disagree about the comment that goes at the top of new files. The one in `project/` asks for `// Owner: orders-team`; the one in its parent folder asks for `// Owner: platform-team`. I used `orders-team` because that file is closer to the new code.
